why: P2 of the external audit, and the fix already existed in another module without having been propagated. `core.quotePath` is true by default on EVERY system, so `git ls-files` without `-z` returns `configuração.mjs` -- the fixture file name stays Portuguese, it is the accent that is being tested -- as `"configura\\303\\247\\303\\243o.mjs"`, quoted and escaped. `lerRepo` passed that quoting along as if it were a file name, `readFileSync` failed, and the failure was swallowed: the file left the scoreboard without having been read. Measured in the secret scanner, where the same defect let an AWS key pass GREEN. The `phone` rule was chosen because it READS the content: a rule that only looks at the name would not expose the read failing. Both sides have the file with the accent in the name; only the fail side has the phone number inside. Whoever takes the `-z` off `lerRepo` makes the fail side go GREEN, which is the original false negative.
